name: r3ath3-os
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y qemu-system-x86 python3 build-essential git curl ca-certificates && (command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain none) && . "$HOME/.cargo/env" && rustup toolchain install 1.83.0 --profile minimal --target x86_64-unknown-none --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && rustup default 1.83.0 && rustc --version && qemu-system-x86_64 --version
